grades: Local high school and undergraduate students
pay_detail: No cost or pay is mentioned on the page.
name: Virtual Mentor Program
what_you_do: Get matched with a current Rosalind Franklin University student. They mentor you about health care or science careers. After an orientation, you meet once a month by Zoom or phone from October to May.
who_can_apply: Local high school and college students who like health care or science.
how_to_apply: Use the Register for the Virtual Mentor Program link (a Google form) on the pathway programs page. You must attend an orientation before being matched.
notes: Online, so you do not need to travel to North Chicago.
org: Rosalind Franklin University of Medicine and Science
